0022600135.text: The Indiana Pacers (2-1, 2nd in the Central and 5th in the East) host the Philadelphia 76ers (3-1, 1st in the Atlantic and 2nd in the East) in the Pacers' fifth game of the 2026-27 season, with Indiana on a one-game winning streak, a 2-0 road record, and a 0-1 home mark. Indiana is missing Andrew Nembhard (back soreness), Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (back fracture), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain) and lists Jabari Walker, Joel Embiid, and VJ Edgecombe as day-to-day with game-time decisions. The Pacers lost 0-4 to the 76ers in 2025-26, most recently 105-94 in Indianapolis on April 10, and the teams have not yet played each other in 2026-27.
